seoDescription: School and office supplies in Manila. Explore paper, pens, notebooks and stationery. Request a quotation for individual, bulk and custom orders.

faq.question: How do I place an order?
faq.answer: Browse the catalog, choose your variants and quantities, and send a quote request or contact us. We confirm availability, final pricing, delivery and the next steps with you.

faq.question: Can I order in bulk?
faq.answer: Yes, send your required items and quantities. Minimum quantities, availability and pricing are confirmed case by case.

faq.question: Do you offer customised stationery?
faq.answer: Tell us what you have in mind. Feasibility, minimum quantities, samples and lead times must be confirmed before a custom order can be accepted.

faq.question: Are website prices final?
faq.answer: Approved website prices are indicative. Your quotation confirms the final product price, availability and delivery charges.

faq.question: Can I pick up my items?
faq.answer: Pickup can be arranged in Tondo, Manila. Please confirm the location and time with us before travelling.

faq.question: Do you deliver outside Metro Manila?
faq.answer: Courier shipping can be discussed for destinations outside Metro Manila. Coverage, fees and dispatch timing are confirmed individually.

faq.question: What if my delivery arrives damaged?
faq.answer: Contact us promptly with your quotation reference and photos of the item and packaging so we can review the issue and advise the next steps.
